Description

Light-and-fast, multi-sport versatility: the all-new Tempest Velocity 20 ups the ante on speed and efficiency for your pursuits, be it PR-setting, bagging peaks or linking quick laps on snow. With a running-vest-inspired harness, flexible backpanel and lightweight design, it provides access to the essentials without skipping a beat. A certified bluesign®®product.

Features

  • Top cinch closure allows top compression
  • 500ml soft-flask compatible pockets with stabilization loops
  • Large zippered phone pocket and small stash pocket
  • Dual-access stretch side pockets
  • Dual SR-buckled side compression straps allows for external attachment
  • External hydration sleeve
  • Dual low-profile pole/axe attachments
  • Stretch-mesh front shove-it pocket can hold a helmet
  • Emergency whistle on sternum strap
  • Low-profile Stow-on-the-Go pole holder
  • Elastic web-keepers on all webbing straps
  • Right side zippered hipbelt pocket
  • Left side stretch stash pocket

Warning: This product can expose you to chemicals including dimethylformamide, which is known to the State of California to cause cancer. For more information, go to oehha.ca.gov/proposition-65/about-proposition-65(Opens in a new window)

Key Attributes

Up Your Tempo

Uniquely pairs the award-winning, multi-sport features of Talon with a soft-flask compatible, running-vest inspired harness, providing elevated efficiency and versatility for fast movement across any landscape.

Category-Leading Fit & Comfort

Our revolutionary design allows for up to four inches of torso adjustment, guaranteeing that fit and function are uncompromised by the hybrid pack design. Tune it for your body and let the vest-style harness, pockets and hipbelt support you where they belong.

Versatile Design

Dynamic fit and thoughtful features provide the Tempest Velocity with versatile multi-sport performance for fast-paced action, whether you’re on foot, bike or skis. More flexible than other Tempest packs, the Velocity backpanel is designed to prioritize freedom of movement, no matter how you approach your objective.

bluesign®Product

This product has been certified to meet bluesign®product requirements, ensuring that environmental and social considerations have gone into its design.

Carry Information

AirScape™ Backpanel

Mesh covered EVA foam on an Atilon framesheet wraps the body and effectively transfers dynamic load while providing ample breathability Hook-and-loop adjustable yoke

BioStretch Harness and Hipbelt

BioStretch harness and padded hipbelt offer maximum flexibility without sacrificing stability for dynamic body movement Spacermesh over die-cut foam provides breathable, comfortable contact surface Two elasticated sternum straps with cam-lock adjustable sliders

BioStretch Hipbelt

Seamless lumbar-to-hipbelt body wrap and BioStretch seams offer maximum flexibility without sacrificing stability for dynamic body movement Spacermesh over die-cut foam provides breathable, comfortable contact surface Crossbody ErgoPull hipbelt system to pull lumbar into body
